responsibility: Declares the public SSA_NAME management API and metadata structures used throughout tree-SSA. It defines ptr_info_def for pointer SSA names’ points-to and alignment facts, macros and iteration helpers for a function’s SSA name vector and default definitions, and the interfaces to create, copy, duplicate, release, and rename SSA names, set/query range and nonzero-bit information, manage pointer alignment and nonnull facts, reset flow-sensitive metadata, release statement defs, and flush the SSA-name freelist; this is the companion header to the SSA name allocator/metadata implementation in tree-ssanames.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the public SSA_NAME management API and related metadata structures/macros, such as ptr_info_def, SSANAMES accessors, creation/copy/release helpers, and range/alignment interfaces. Unlike gcc/tree-ssanames.cc, it does not implement allocation, freelist reuse, version compaction, or metadata-copy mechanics.
